She is wearing a white t-shirt, a black leather-style jacket, and white Adidas track pants with black stripes, pulling a large black hardshell suitcase. Above her, multiple large, circular decorative lights with iridescent, multicolored patterns are suspended from the high, industrial ceiling. In the background, white and silver cars are parked or idling near terminal signage under bright artificial lighting. (2) A sudden jump cut transitions the scene to the Grand Canyon at midday. The woman is now standing on a rocky cliff edge, wearing a brown form-fitting sleeveless dress and a small brown shoulder bag with a gold buckle. She raises her arms gracefully above her head and turns back to smile at the camera. The background features the vast, reddish-brown geological layers of the canyon under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds, showcasing sharp natural lighting and immense depth.
